overview_description.description:
FutureLeague is an ed-tech company that teaches kids ages 6-12 engineering and programming with a focus on teamwork, creativity, and design thinking. It specializes in the fields of ed-tech, internet, and education.

It was founded in 2014 and headquartered in San Francisco, California.
